title: Theo and the Spire
author: Kestrel Sterling
blurb: Lior Nakamura, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
